address: 3-4 Eccleston Yards, Belgravia, London, SW1W 9AZ, United Kingdom
bio: This laid-back brasserie is located in a former power station and coal store; the lofty glass roof ensures it’s light and airy, and the open kitchen gives it a real buzz. Rustic, Mediterranean-influenced dishes are tasty and satisfying, with bold flavours and the occasional Asian touch....
